source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  classical
  refine Polynomial.eq_zero_of_infinite_isRoot q ?_
  have hsub : {c : k | c ≠ 0} ⊆ {c : k | q.IsRoot c} := by
    intro c hc
    have hcz : c ≠ 0 := hc
    have hval : Polynomial.aeval (flagEvalAlg (matEval_totalDenom_lowerTwo hcz) (tCoord k)) q
        = flagEvalAlg (matEval_totalDenom_lowerTwo hcz) (Polynomial.aeval (tCoord k) q) :=
      Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply _ _ _
    rw [hq, map_zero, flagEvalAlg_apply, flagEval_tCoord_lowerTwo hcz] at hval
    show q.eval c = 0
    rw [← Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval]
    exact hval
  refine Set.Infinite.mono hsub ?_
  have hcompl : {c : k | c ≠ 0} = ({0} : Set k)ᶜ := by
    ext c
    simp [Set.mem_compl_iff]
  rw [hcompl]
  exact Set.Finite.infinite_compl (Set.finite_singleton 0)

    (hall : ∀ q : XiZeroCopy, |(xiSpectralPoint q).im| ≤ Θ)
    (hord : ∀ q : XiZeroCopy, g ≤ |(xiSpectralPoint q).re|) (hγ : g ≤ |γ|) :

    (hall : ∀ q : XiZeroCopy, |(xiSpectralPoint q).im| ≤ Θ)
    (hord : ∀ q : XiZeroCopy, g ≤ |(xiSpectralPoint q).re|) (hγ : g ≤ |γ|) :
    Summable (fun q : XiZeroCopy => ExpPoly.decayNorm (normalizedRayTermPoly Θ γ q))

by
  classical
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hMb⟩ := exists_plateau_coeff_bound
  set K : ℝ := (8 * (M * Real.exp (Θ / 4))) ^ (2 : ℕ) / min 1 (min Θ g) with hK
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ K := by
    have : 0 < min 1 (min Θ g) := lt_min one_pos (lt_min hΘ hg)
    positivity
  set F : Finset XiZeroCopy := (finite_not_farFromCentre γ).toFinset with hF
  have hsum1 : Summable (fun q : XiZeroCopy => K * (1 / (4 * ‖xiSpectralPoint q‖ ^ (2 : ℕ)))) := by
    have := xiSpectralPoint_inv_sq_summable.mul_left (K / 4)
    refine this.congr fun q => ?_
    ring
  have hsum2 : Summable (fun q : XiZeroCopy =>
      if q ∈ F then ExpPoly.decayNorm (normalizedRayTermPoly Θ γ q) else 0) := by
    refine summable_of_ne_finset_zero (s := F) fun q hq => ?_
    simp [hq]
  refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun q => ExpPoly.decayNorm_nonneg _) (fun q => ?_)
    (hsum1.add hsum2)
  by_cases hfar : FarFromCentre γ q
  · have hqF : q ∉ F := by
      simp only [hF, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, mem_setOf_eq, not_not]
      exact hfar
    rw [if_neg hqF, add_zero]
    exact decayNorm_normalizedRayTermPoly_le_far hΘ hg hM hMb (hall q) (hord q) hγ hfar
  · have hqF : q ∈ F := by
      simp only [hF, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, mem_setOf_eq]
      exact hfar
    rw [if_pos hqF]
    have : 0 ≤ K * (1 / (4 * ‖xiSpectralPoint q‖ ^ (2 : ℕ))) := by positivity
    linarith

  classical
  set p : Polynomial k := r.comp (-Polynomial.X) with hp
  have hpe : ∀ y : k, p.eval y = r.eval (-y) := by
    intro y; simp [hp, Polynomial.eval_comp]

  set pr := p.reflect D with hpr

    intro x hx

    rw [hinv] at hmain
    simp only [Polynomial.eval₂_id] at hmain
    rw [← hmain, ← hpr,
      show (x : k) ^ D * (Polynomial.eval x pr * (x⁻¹ : k) ^ D)

    rw [← hD, max_self, ← hpr] at h0

          conv_lhs => rw [← MvPolynomial.sum_homogeneousComponent p, ← hM]
          rw [map_sum]

/-!
# Exact pole clearing for the denominator-three deficit

The deficit is measured below one copy of the xi divisor. Its finite support
gives a monic polynomial with exactly the missing multiplicities. Multiplying
the completion by that polynomial permits entire division by xi, and the
quotient has finite order without a zero-free assumption.

The final alternative assumes only the original analytic datum and its
nonzero value at one. It does not rule out the finite-deficit branch.
-/

noncomputable section

open Complex Set Polynomial
open GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry

namespace RHTower.WeilHigherDenominator

/-- The polynomial carrying a prescribed finite effective divisor. -/
def finitePolePolynomial (S : Finset ℂ) (d : ℂ → ℕ) : Polynomial ℂ :=
  ∏ ρ ∈ S, (X - C ρ) ^ d ρ

theorem finitePolePolynomial_monic (S : Finset ℂ) (d : ℂ → ℕ) :
    (finitePolePolynomial S d).Monic :=
  monic_prod_of_monic S _ fun ρ _ => (monic_X_sub_C ρ).pow (d ρ)

theorem finitePolePolynomial_natDegree (S : Finset ℂ) (d : ℂ → ℕ) :
    (finitePolePolynomial S d).natDegree = ∑ ρ ∈ S, d ρ := by
  rw [finitePolePolynomial, natDegree_prod_of_monic S _
    (fun ρ _ => (monic_X_sub_C ρ).pow (d ρ))]
  simp

/-- No extra zero multiplicities are introduced by the clearing polynomial. -/
theorem finitePolePolynomial_order (S : Finset ℂ) (d : ℂ → ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    analyticOrderAt (fun w => (finitePolePolynomial S d).eval w) z =
      if z ∈ S then (d z : ℕ∞) else 0 := by
  classical
  induction S using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    have h : analyticOrderAt (fun _ : ℂ => (1 : ℂ)) z = 0 :=
      analyticAt_const.analyticOrderAt_eq_zero.mpr one_ne_zero
    simpa [finitePolePolynomial] using h
  | @insert a S ha ih =>
    have hfun : (fun w => (finitePolePolynomial (insert a S) d).eval w) =
        (fun w => (w - a) ^ d a) * fun w => (finitePolePolynomial S d).eval w := by
      ext w
      simp [finitePolePolynomial, Finset.prod_insert, ha]
    rw [hfun, analyticOrderAt_mul (analyticAt_sub_pow a (d a) z)
      ((finitePolePolynomial S d).differentiable.differentiableOn.analyticAt
        Filter.univ_mem), ih]
    by_cases hza : z = a
    · subst z
      simp [analyticOrderAt_sub_pow_self, ha]
    · rw [analyticOrderAt_sub_pow_of_ne a (d a) hza]
      simp [hza]

/-- Missing multiplicity below one copy of xi, not below its cube. -/
def xiDeficit (E : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℕ :=
  analyticOrderNatAt xi z - analyticOrderNatAt E z

def xiDeficitSupport (E : ℂ → ℂ) : Set ℂ :=
  {z | analyticOrderNatAt E z < analyticOrderNatAt xi z}

private lemma order_ne_top {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    (hf1 : f 1 ≠ 0) (z : ℂ) : analyticOrderAt f z ≠ ⊤ := by
  intro ht
  have hz := (AnalyticOnNhd.analyticOrderAt_eq_top_iff_eq_zero z
    (fun w => hf.differentiableOn.analyticAt Filter.univ_mem)).mp ht
  exact hf1 (congrFun hz 1)

private lemma xi_one_ne_zero : xi 1 ≠ 0 := by rw [xi_one]; norm_num

theorem xiDeficit_one (E : ℂ → ℂ) : xiDeficit E 1 = 0 := by
  have hz := (xi_analyticOnNhd_univ 1 (mem_univ _)).analyticOrderAt_eq_zero.mpr
    xi_one_ne_zero
  simp [xiDeficit, analyticOrderNatAt, hz]

/-- The canonical finite polynomial has exactly the deficit order everywhere. -/
theorem finiteDeficitPolynomial_order {E : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hS : (xiDeficitSupport E).Finite) (z : ℂ) :
    analyticOrderAt (fun w => (finitePolePolynomial hS.toFinset (xiDeficit E)).eval w) z =
      (xiDeficit E z : ℕ∞) := by
  rw [finitePolePolynomial_order]
  split_ifs with hz
  · rfl
  · have hle : analyticOrderNatAt xi z ≤ analyticOrderNatAt E z := by
      simpa [hS.mem_toFinset, xiDeficitSupport, not_lt] using hz
    simp [xiDeficit, Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hle]

private lemma finiteOrder_of_orderOne_bound {f : ℂ → ℂ} {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hf : ∀ z, ‖f z‖ ≤ Real.exp (C * (1 + ‖z‖) * Real.log (2 + ‖z‖))) :
    FiniteOrderEnvelope f := by
  refine ⟨C, 2, hC, fun z => (hf z).trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)⟩
  have hl : Real.log (2 + ‖z‖) ≤ 1 + ‖z‖ := by
    have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 2 + ‖z‖)
    linarith
  calc
    C * (1 + ‖z‖) * Real.log (2 + ‖z‖) ≤ C * (1 + ‖z‖) * (1 + ‖z‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl (by positivity)
    _ = C * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ 2 := by ring

/-- Entire division and finite growth for the exact finite-deficit polynomial. -/
theorem finiteDeficit_entire_normalForm {E : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hE : Differentiable ℂ E) (hE1 : E 1 ≠ 0) (hEfinite : FiniteOrderEnvelope E)
    (hS : (xiDeficitSupport E).Finite) :
    ∃ H : ℂ → ℂ, Differentiable ℂ H ∧ FiniteOrderEnvelope H ∧ H 1 ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ z, (finitePolePolynomial hS.toFinset (xiDeficit E)).eval z * E z = H z * xi z := by
  let P := finitePolePolynomial hS.toFinset (xiDeficit E)

# The actual logarithmic-polynomial theta defect

The exact residue identity becomes a finite packet with all pole orders retained.
Every interior clearing root lies in the open critical strip and contributes a
nonzero polynomial. Endpoint contributions remain explicit in the finite set.
-/

/-- One family of polynomials represents all residues, with a sharp removability criterion. -/
theorem exists_poleCleared_residue_polynomials (P : Polynomial ℂ) {H : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hH : Differentiable ℂ H) :
    ∃ Q : ℂ → Polynomial ℂ,
      (∀ ρ : ℂ, ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x →
        laurentCoeff (fun s => (x : ℂ) ^ (-s) * poleClearedDegreeTwoCompletion P H s) ρ (-1) =
          (x : ℂ) ^ (-ρ) * (Q ρ).eval (Real.log x : ℂ)) ∧
      ∀ ρ : ℂ, Q ρ = 0 ↔ 0 ≤ meromorphicOrderAt (poleClearedDegreeTwoCompletion P H) ρ := by
  have h := fun ρ => exists_mellin_residue_polynomial (poleClearedDegreeTwoCompletion_meromorphicAt P hH ρ)
  choose Q hrep hzero using h
  exact ⟨Q, hrep, hzero⟩

/-- The original datum yields the actual finite logarithmic packet or infinitely many deficits. -/
theorem degreeThree_infiniteDeficits_or_logPolynomialDefect {g : ℕ → ℂ} {E : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hD : WeilZetaPower.ZetaPowerDatum 3 g E) (hE1 : E 1 ≠ 0) :
    (xiDeficitSupport E).Infinite ∨
      ∃ (P : Polynomial ℂ) (H : ℂ → ℂ) (ε : ℂ) (Q : ℂ → Polynomial ℂ),
        P.Monic ∧ ‖ε‖ = 1 ∧ (∀ s, E (1 - s) = ε * E s) ∧
        (∀ z, analyticOrderAt (fun w => P.eval w) z = (xiDeficit E z : ℕ∞)) ∧
        Differentiable ℂ H ∧ FiniteOrderEnvelope H ∧ H 1 ≠ 0 ∧
        (∀ z, P.eval z * E z = H z * xi z) ∧
        (∀ ρ : ℂ, Q ρ = 0 ↔ 0 ≤ meromorphicOrderAt (poleClearedDegreeTwoCompletion P H) ρ) ∧
        (∀ ρ ∈ P.roots.toFinset, 0 < ρ.re ∧ ρ.re < 1 ∧ Q ρ ≠ 0) ∧
        ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x →
          MaassThetaMellin.kTheta (degreeTwoQuotientCoeff g) x -
              ε * ((x : ℂ) ^ (-1 : ℂ) * MaassThetaMellin.kTheta (degreeTwoQuotientCoeff g) x⁻¹) =
            (1 / 4 : ℂ) * ∑ ρ ∈ degreeTwoPoleSet P,
              (x : ℂ) ^ (-ρ) * (Q ρ).eval (Real.log x : ℂ) := by
  rcases degreeThree_infiniteDeficits_or_poleCleared hD hE1 with hi | ⟨P, H, hm, _, ho, hd, hg, h₁, hf⟩
  · exact Or.inl hi
  · obtain ⟨ε, hε, he⟩ := hD.exists_sign
    obtain ⟨Q, hrep, hzero⟩ := exists_poleCleared_residue_polynomials P hd
    refine Or.inr ⟨P, H, ε, Q, hm, hε, he, ho, hd, hg, h₁, hf, hzero, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro ρ hρ
      have hp : P.eval ρ = 0 := Polynomial.isRoot_of_mem_roots (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mp hρ)
      have hr := deficitPolynomial_root_re_mem_Ioo P ho hp
      refine ⟨hr.1, hr.2, ?_⟩
      intro hq
      exact (not_le_of_gt (poleClearedDegreeTwoCompletion_order_neg_at_root
        hD.entire hE1 hd h₁ P hf ho hp)) ((hzero ρ).mp hq)
    · intro x hx
      rw [degreeTwoQuotient_theta_defect hD he P hm.ne_zero hd hg hf ho hx]
      congr 1
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ρ _ => hrep ρ x hx

/-!
# Homogeneity and finite dimensionality of the Borel–Weil sections

A section of the Borel–Weil line bundle attached to `lam` is homogeneous of degree `∑ i, lam i`:
this is the scalar case `B = t • 1` of the `B`-equivariance.  Consequently the section space sits
inside a finitely generated homogeneous piece of the polynomial ring, hence is finite dimensional.

## Main results

* `eval_smul_of_isHomogeneous` — homogeneous polynomials scale under scaling of the argument.
* `isHomogeneous_of_eval_smul` — the converse over an infinite field.
* `polySections_le_homogeneousSubmodule`
* `finiteDimensional_polySections`
-/

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false

namespace GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry.BorelWeil

open Matrix MvPolynomial

/-- A homogeneous polynomial of degree `e` scales by `t ^ e` when the argument is scaled. -/
theorem eval_smul_of_isHomogeneous {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] {k : Type*} [CommSemiring k]
    {q : MvPolynomial σ k} {e : ℕ} (hq : q.IsHomogeneous e) (t : k) (x : σ → k) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => t * x i) q = t ^ e * MvPolynomial.eval x q := by
  rw [MvPolynomial.eval_eq', MvPolynomial.eval_eq', Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d hd => ?_
  have hcoef : MvPolynomial.coeff d q ≠ 0 := by rwa [← MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff]
  have hsum : (∑ i : σ, d i) = e := by
    have hw := hq hcoef
    rw [Finsupp.weight_apply] at hw
    rw [← hw, Finsupp.sum_fintype] <;> simp
  calc MvPolynomial.coeff d q * ∏ i : σ, (t * x i) ^ (d i)
      = MvPolynomial.coeff d q * (t ^ (∑ i : σ, d i) * ∏ i : σ, (x i) ^ (d i)) := by
        rw [← Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
        exact congrArg _ (Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => mul_pow _ _ _)
    _ = t ^ e * (MvPolynomial.coeff d q * ∏ i : σ, (x i) ^ (d i)) := by rw [hsum]; ring

/-- Over an infinite field, a polynomial whose evaluations scale by a fixed power is homogeneous of
that degree. -/
theorem isHomogeneous_of_eval_smul {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] {k : Type*} [Field k] [Infinite k]
    {p : MvPolynomial σ k} {d : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ t : k, t ≠ 0 → ∀ x : σ → k,
      MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => t * x i) p = t ^ d * MvPolynomial.eval x p) :
    p.IsHomogeneous d := by
  classical
  set M := p.totalDegree with hM
  have hcomp : ∀ e : ℕ, e ≠ d → MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent e p = 0 := by
    intro e he
    refine (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent_isHomogeneous e
      p).eq_zero_of_forall_eval_eq_zero fun x => ?_
    by_cases hle : e ≤ M
    · -- compare the two one-variable polynomials in the scaling parameter
      set a : ℕ → k := fun e' => MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent e' p)
        with ha
      set A : Polynomial k :=
        ∑ e' ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), Polynomial.C (a e') * Polynomial.X ^ e' with hA
      set B : Polynomial k := Polynomial.C (MvPolynomial.eval x p) * Polynomial.X ^ d with hB
      have hAB : A = B := by
        refine Polynomial.eq_of_infinite_eval_eq _ _ ?_
        refine Set.Infinite.mono ?_ ((Set.finite_singleton (0 : k)).infinite_compl)
        intro t ht
        have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := ht
        have hsplit : MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => t * x i) p
            = ∑ e' ∈ Finset.range (M + 1),
              t ^ e' * MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent e' p) := by
          conv_lhs => rw [← MvPolynomial.sum_homogeneousComponent p, ← hM]
          rw [map_sum]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e' _ =>
            eval_smul_of_isHomogeneous (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent_isHomogeneous e' p) t x
        have hp : MvPolynomial.eval x p
            = ∑ e' ∈ Finset.range (M + 1),
              MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent e' p) := by
          conv_lhs => rw [← MvPolynomial.sum_homogeneousComponent p, ← hM]
          rw [map_sum]
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, hA, hB, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum, Polynomial.eval_mul,
          Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X]
        rw [show (MvPolynomial.eval x) p * t ^ d = t ^ d * (MvPolynomial.eval x) p from
            mul_comm _ _, ← h t ht0 x, hsplit]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e' _ => by rw [ha]; ring
      have hcA : A.coeff e = a e := by
        rw [hA, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single e]
        · simp
        · intro e' _ hne
          simp [Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, Ne.symm hne]
        · intro hnot
          exact absurd (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hle)) hnot
      have hcB : B.coeff e = 0 := by
        rw [hB, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, if_neg he, mul_zero]
      rw [hAB, hcB] at hcA
      exact hcA.symm
    · rw [MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent_eq_zero e p (by omega)]
      simp

theorem gram_zero_zero

    gram J a 0 0 = ((‖a‖ ^ (2 : ℕ) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by

@[simp]
theorem gram_zero_one
    (J : H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] H) (hJ : Function.Involutive J) (a : H) :
    gram J a 0 1 = Complex.I * (quadratic J a : ℂ) := by
  change inner ℂ a (Complex.I • J a) = _
  rw [inner_smul_right,
    ← inner_map_left_eq_inner_map_right J hJ a a,
    inner_map_self_eq_quadratic J hJ a]

@[simp]
theorem gram_one_zero
    (J : H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] H) (hJ : Function.Involutive J) (a : H) :
    gram J a 1 0 = -Complex.I * (quadratic J a : ℂ) := by
  change inner ℂ (Complex.I • J a) a = _
  rw [inner_smul_left, inner_map_self_eq_quadratic J hJ a]
  simp

theorem gram_one_one
    (J : H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] H) (a : H) :
    gram J a 1 1 = ((‖a‖ ^ (2 : ℕ) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
  change inner ℂ (Complex.I • J a) (Complex.I • J a) = _
  have hI : (starRingEnd ℂ) Complex.I * Complex.I = 1 := by
    rw [Complex.conj_I]
    simp [Complex.I_mul_I]
  rw [inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, J.inner_map_map, ← mul_assoc, hI, one_mul]
  simp [inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K]

/-- Closed form of the Clifford Gram matrix. -/
theorem gram_eq
    (J : H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] H) (hJ : Function.Involutive J) (a : H) :
    gram J a =
      !![((‖a‖ ^ (2 : ℕ) : ℝ) : ℂ), Complex.I * (quadratic J a : ℂ);
        -Complex.I * (quadratic J a : ℂ), ((‖a‖ ^ (2 : ℕ) : ℝ) : ℂ)] := by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [gram_zero_zero, gram_zero_one,
    gram_one_zero, gram_one_one, hJ]

  change (xiWeilHilbertQuadratic (xiWeilEvaluationLp F hF) : ℂ) = _

/-!
# Clifford-corrected CCM product and the Xi Weil coefficient

The two opposite Clifford phases cancel in the product of literal closed CCM Lefschetz
correspondences.  On the multiplicity-exact Xi Hilbert carrier, the corresponding two-channel
Gram matrix is positive semidefinite and its Clifford-graded trace is exactly the Weil quadratic
coefficient.  The final theorem separates unconditional matrix positivity from scalar positivity:
the latter, on the full square-summable test domain, is equivalent to RH.
-/

open CategoryTheory Complex
open scoped ComplexOrder

namespace GaloisForLFunctions.RHTower

private abbrev Section := CCMRationalClassSpaceSection
private abbrev Relative :=
  CCMRationalAdelicClosedNonunitalStrongRelativeCyclicModule
private abbrev RelativeKReal :=
  ccmRationalAdelicClosedNonunitalStrongRelativeCyclicKReal

/-- Opposite Clifford phase on a literal closed CCM Lefschetz correspondence. -/
def ccmRationalAdelicClosedNonunitalStrongCliffordCotransgression
    (c : Section) :
    CyclicModule.KRealAntiHom RelativeKReal RelativeKReal where
  toHom :=
    (ccmRationalAdelicClosedNonunitalStrongLefschetzKReal c).toHom.smul (-Complex.I)
  real_antinaturality n x := by
    rw [CyclicModule.Hom.smul_degree_apply, map_smulₛₗ,
      (ccmRationalAdelicClosedNonunitalStrongLefschetzKReal c).real_naturality,
      CyclicModule.Hom.smul_degree_apply]
    simp

@[simp]
theorem ccmRationalAdelicClosedNonunitalStrongCliffordCotransgression_apply
    (c : Section) (n : ℕ) (x : Relative.simplicial.degree n) :
    (ccmRationalAdelicClosedNonunitalStrongCliffordCotransgression c).toHom.simplicial.app
        (.op (.mk n)) x =
      (-Complex.I) •
        (ccmRationalAdelicClosedNonunitalStrongLefschetz c).simplicial.app
          (.op (.mk n)) x :=
  rfl

/-- Exact phase-cancellation/product law on the literal closed CCM quotient. -/
theorem ccmRationalAdelicClosedNonunitalStrongClifford_corrected_product_degree
    (c d : Section) (n : ℕ) (x : Relative.simplicial.degree n) :
    (ccmRationalAdelicClosedNonunitalStrongCliffordCotransgression c).toHom.simplicial.app
        (.op (.mk n))
        ((ccmRationalAdelicClosedNonunitalStrongCliffordTransgression d).toHom.simplicial.app
          (.op (.mk n)) x) =
      (ccmRationalAdelicClosedNonunitalStrongLefschetz (c * d)).simplicial.app
        (.op (.mk n)) x := by
  change (-Complex.I) •
      (ccmRationalAdelicClosedNonunitalStrongLefschetz c).simplicial.app
        (.op (.mk n))
        (Complex.I •
          (ccmRationalAdelicClosedNonunitalStrongLefschetz d).simplicial.app
            (.op (.mk n)) x) = _
  rw [map_smul, smul_smul,
    ccmRationalAdelicClosedNonunitalStrongLefschetz_mul_degree]
  simp

end GaloisForLFunctions.RHTower

variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]

/-- Real coefficient of an involutive isometry. -/
def quadratic (J : H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] H) (a : H) : ℝ :=
  (inner ℂ (J a) a).re

/-- An involutive linear isometry is self-adjoint. -/
theorem inner_map_left_eq_inner_map_right
    (J : H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] H) (hJ : Function.Involutive J) (a b : H) :
    inner ℂ (J a) b = inner ℂ a (J b) := by
  calc
    inner ℂ (J a) b = inner ℂ (J (J a)) (J b) :=
      (J.inner_map_map (J a) b).symm
    _ = inner ℂ a (J b) := by rw [hJ a]

/-- The quadratic coefficient of an involutive isometry has no imaginary part. -/
theorem inner_map_self_eq_quadratic
    (J : H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] H) (hJ : Function.Involutive J) (a : H) :
    inner ℂ (J a) a = (quadratic J a : ℂ) := by
  apply (Complex.conj_eq_iff_re.mp ?_).symm
  calc
    (starRingEnd ℂ) (inner ℂ (J a) a) = inner ℂ a (J a) := inner_conj_symm a (J a)
    _ = inner ℂ (J a) a :=
      (inner_map_left_eq_inner_map_right J hJ a a).symm

/-- Two-channel Clifford packet attached to `a` and the reflected vector `Ja`. -/
def packet (J : H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] H) (a : H) : Fin 2 → H :=
  ![a, Complex.I • J a]

/-- Positive matrix lift of the indefinite quadratic coefficient. -/
def gram (J : H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] H) (a : H) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  Matrix.gram ℂ (packet J a)

/-- Clifford grading extracting the reflected off-diagonal coefficient. -/
def grading : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  !![0, Complex.I; -Complex.I, 0]

/-- Normalized Clifford-graded trace of the positive matrix lift. -/
def coefficient (J : H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] H) (a : H) : ℂ :=
  (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ * Matrix.trace (grading * gram J a)

@[simp]
theorem gram_zero_zero
    (J : H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] H) (a : H) :
    gram J a 0 0 = ((‖a‖ ^ (2 : ℕ) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
  simp [gram, packet, Matrix.gram_apply, inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K]

/-!
# The prime-free restricted Weil family

Removing the whole finite prime block from the restricted Weil remainder leaves the archimedean
scalar and the polar rank-two operator.  This *prime-free* remainder is an aperture-compatible
family in the sense of `CCMRemainderFamily`, its quadratic form on the archimedean form domain is
the archimedean multiplier integral plus the polar term, and on pole-vanishing sources it reduces
to the archimedean multiplier integral alone.  Below the aperture `½ log 2` no prime is visible,
so the prime-free family coincides with the literal one there.
-/

open scoped ENNReal InnerProduct
open GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry

noncomputable section

namespace RHTower.WeilDeletion

/-! ## The prime-free remainder -/

/-- The literal remainder with the finite prime block added back: the archimedean scalar plus the
polar operator. -/
def ccmPrimeFreeRemainder (a : SuzukiPositiveAperture) :
    suzukiApertureHilbert a →L[ℂ] suzukiApertureHilbert a :=
  ccmRestrictedWeilBoundedRemainder a + ccmFinitePrimeOperator a

theorem ccmPrimeFreeRemainder_isSelfAdjoint (a : SuzukiPositiveAperture) :
    IsSelfAdjoint (ccmPrimeFreeRemainder a) := by
  unfold ccmPrimeFreeRemainder
  have h1 := ccmRestrictedWeilBoundedRemainder_isSelfAdjoint a
  have h2 := ccmFinitePrimeOperator_isSelfAdjoint a
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.isSelfAdjoint_iff'] at h1 h2 ⊢
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint.map_add, h1, h2]

/-- The real diagonal of the finite prime block is the source-formula prime sum. -/
theorem re_inner_ccmFinitePrimeOperator_eq (a : SuzukiPositiveAperture)
    (f : suzukiApertureHilbert a) :
    (inner ℂ (ccmFinitePrimeOperator a f) f).re =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (Nat.floor (Real.exp (2 * a.1))),
        (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℝ) * (1 / Real.sqrt n) *
          (inner ℂ (logTranslationCLM (Real.log n) f.1) f.1 +
            inner ℂ (logTranslationCLM (-Real.log n) f.1) f.1).re := by
  rw [inner_ccmFinitePrimeOperator, Complex.re_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
  rw [inner_ccmPrimeTransportOperator, ← mul_assoc, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.re_ofReal_mul]

theorem primeFree_diagonal_eq_of_val_eq {a b : SuzukiPositiveAperture} (hab : a.1 ≤ b.1)
    {u : CCMArchimedeanFormDomain a} {v : CCMArchimedeanFormDomain b} (hvu : v.1 = u.1) :
    (inner ℂ (ccmPrimeFreeRemainder b (ccmArchimedeanFormToAperture b v))
        (ccmArchimedeanFormToAperture b v)).re =
      (inner ℂ (ccmPrimeFreeRemainder a (ccmArchimedeanFormToAperture a u))
        (ccmArchimedeanFormToAperture a u)).re := by
  unfold ccmPrimeFreeRemainder
  rw [add_apply, add_apply, inner_add_left, inner_add_left, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_re,
    literal_diagonal_eq_of_val_eq hab hvu, re_inner_ccmFinitePrimeOperator_eq,
    re_inner_ccmFinitePrimeOperator_eq]
  congr 1
  have hcoe : ((ccmArchimedeanFormToAperture b v : suzukiApertureHilbert b) : SoninL2) =
      ((ccmArchimedeanFormToAperture a u : suzukiApertureHilbert a) : SoninL2) :=
    ccmArchimedeanFormToAperture_coe_eq_of_val_eq hvu
  rw [hcoe]
  exact ccmFinitePrimeQuadraticSum_eq_of_le hab (ccmArchimedeanFormToAperture a u)

  selfAdjoint a := ccmPrimeFreeRemainder_isSelfAdjoint a

    intro a b hab u v hvu

/-!
# Unconditional Hilbert realization of the Xi Weil form

Critical-line reflection permutes the multiplicity-exact Xi divisor.  Reindexing an `ell^(2 : ℕ)`
evaluation vector by this permutation realizes the Weil polarization as an ordinary Hilbert inner
product without assuming RH.  The reindexing preserves the norm, so the zero-side Weil form is a
bounded Hermitian form on its complete square-summable evaluation carrier.

This is the continuity bridge needed to pass positivity from an algebraic source-generated core to
its Hilbert closure.  It does not assert that the regular Cauchy core is dense in every divisor
evaluation vector; detecting the finite off-real sign vectors remains the top-down density problem.
-/

open Complex

namespace RHTower

noncomputable section

/-- Critical-line reflection acting on the multiplicity-exact Xi `ell^(2 : ℕ)` carrier. -/
def xiWeilLineConjLp (v : lp (fun _ : XiZeroCopy => ℂ) 2) :
    lp (fun _ : XiZeroCopy => ℂ) 2 :=
  ⟨fun q => v (xiZeroCopyLineConjEquiv q),
    HilbertSchmidt.memℓp_of_sq
      (xiZeroCopyLineConjEquiv.summable_iff.mpr
        (HilbertSchmidt.summable_coe_sq v))⟩

@[simp] theorem xiWeilLineConjLp_apply
    (v : lp (fun _ : XiZeroCopy => ℂ) 2) (q : XiZeroCopy) :
    xiWeilLineConjLp v q = v (xiZeroCopyLineConjEquiv q) := rfl

/-- Critical-line reflection preserves the `ell^(2 : ℕ)` norm unconditionally. -/
theorem norm_xiWeilLineConjLp (v : lp (fun _ : XiZeroCopy => ℂ) 2) :
    ‖xiWeilLineConjLp v‖ = ‖v‖ := by
  have hsq : ‖xiWeilLineConjLp v‖ ^ (2 : ℕ) = ‖v‖ ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
    rw [HilbertSchmidt.lp_norm_sq_eq, HilbertSchmidt.lp_norm_sq_eq]
    exact xiZeroCopyLineConjEquiv.tsum_eq (fun q => ‖v q‖ ^ (2 : ℕ))
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (xiWeilLineConjLp v), norm_nonneg v]

/-- Critical-line reflection as a linear isometry of the Xi `ell^(2 : ℕ)` carrier. -/
def xiWeilLineConjLinearIsometry :
    lp (fun _ : XiZeroCopy => ℂ) 2 →ₗᵢ[ℂ] lp (fun _ : XiZeroCopy => ℂ) 2 where
  toFun := xiWeilLineConjLp
  map_add' v w := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext q
    rfl
  map_smul' c v := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext q
    rfl
  norm_map' := norm_xiWeilLineConjLp

@[simp] theorem xiWeilLineConjLinearIsometry_apply
    (v : lp (fun _ : XiZeroCopy => ℂ) 2) :
    xiWeilLineConjLinearIsometry v = xiWeilLineConjLp v := rfl

/-- The real quadratic form carried by critical-line reflection on the Xi `ell^(2 : ℕ)` space. -/
def xiWeilHilbertQuadratic (v : lp (fun _ : XiZeroCopy => ℂ) 2) : ℝ :=
  (inner ℂ (xiWeilLineConjLinearIsometry v) v).re

/-- The unconditional Xi Hilbert quadratic form is continuous. -/
theorem continuous_xiWeilHilbertQuadratic : Continuous xiWeilHilbertQuadratic := by
  unfold xiWeilHilbertQuadratic
  fun_prop

/-- Positivity on the algebraic regular-Cauchy core automatically extends to its Hilbert closure. -/
theorem xiWeilHilbertQuadratic_nonneg_on_cauchyHilbertSubspace
    (hpos : ∀ v ∈ xiWeilCauchyAlgebraicSubspace, 0 ≤ xiWeilHilbertQuadratic v) :
    ∀ v ∈ xiWeilCauchyHilbertSubspace, 0 ≤ xiWeilHilbertQuadratic v := by
  intro v hv
  have hclosed : IsClosed {w | 0 ≤ xiWeilHilbertQuadratic w} :=
    isClosed_Ici.preimage continuous_xiWeilHilbertQuadratic
  have hv' : v ∈ closure (↑xiWeilCauchyAlgebraicSubspace : Set _) := by
    change v ∈ closure (↑xiWeilCauchyAlgebraicSubspace : Set _) at hv
    exact hv
  exact (closure_minimal hpos hclosed) hv'

/-- The Xi Weil polarization is the Hilbert product after critical-line-reflection reindexing.
No zero-location hypothesis is used. -/
theorem inner_xiWeilLineConjLp_evaluation_eq_polarization
    (F G : ℂ → ℂ) (hF : XiWeilSquareSummable F) (hG : XiWeilSquareSummable G) :
    inner ℂ (xiWeilLineConjLp (xiWeilEvaluationLp G hG))
      (xiWeilEvaluationLp F hF) = xiWeilPolarization F G := by
  rw [lp.inner_eq_tsum, xiWeilPolarization]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro q
  rw [xiWeilLineConjLp_apply, xiWeilEvaluationLp_apply,
    xiWeilEvaluationLp_apply, xiSpectralPoint_lineConj]
  simp [xiWeilSharp, RCLike.inner_apply]

/-- Evaluation identifies the continuous Hilbert quadratic form with the diagonal Weil value. -/
theorem xiWeilHilbertQuadratic_evaluation_eq_polarization_re
    (F : ℂ → ℂ) (hF : XiWeilSquareSummable F) :
    xiWeilHilbertQuadratic (xiWeilEvaluationLp F hF) =
      (xiWeilPolarization F F).re := by
  rw [xiWeilHilbertQuadratic, xiWeilLineConjLinearIsometry_apply,
    inner_xiWeilLineConjLp_evaluation_eq_polarization]

/-- Unconditional Cauchy--Schwarz bound for the Xi Weil polarization on square-summable tests. -/
theorem norm_xiWeilPolarization_le
    (F G : ℂ → ℂ) (hF : XiWeilSquareSummable F) (hG : XiWeilSquareSummable G) :
    ‖xiWeilPolarization F G‖ ≤
      ‖xiWeilEvaluationLp F hF‖ * ‖xiWeilEvaluationLp G hG‖ := by
  rw [← inner_xiWeilLineConjLp_evaluation_eq_polarization F G hF hG]
  calc
    ‖inner ℂ (xiWeilLineConjLp (xiWeilEvaluationLp G hG))
